before.requirement: Print a parser-produced array at every nesting depth accepted by parsing.
before.reason: The old array printer has no depth rejection, and the harness passes the parsed tree to printing.

after.requirement: Print a parser-produced array at every nesting depth accepted by parsing.
after.reason: The new array guard rejects at depth 1000, while array and object parsing reject a container at that same depth. Both print paths begin at depth zero.

claims.reason: The same old harness prints a parser-returned tree on both sides. The added array guard cannot reject an array solely for a nesting depth that parsing accepted.
